claim_to_evidence: RESULT.md Proof: explicit mixed block and unimodular-induction construction
correctness.rationale: The Gallo–Videla brackets produce an alternating K-matrix on V+E with a central zero W block. Its rank is at most twice the vertex dimension. A 5-by-5 mixed-block minor with determinant one exists for K_{2,3}; every added vertex preserves a unimodular minor via a fresh two-path coefficient and previously unused edge column. This gives rank 2(a+b) over all fields whenever {a,b} != {2,2}. For K_{2,2}, the mixed-block determinant is identically zero; the 8-by-8 alternating block is singular and has rank at most six, attained by a three-rank mixed block. Exact code checks 36 witnesses and exhaustive small finite fields; the proof is independent of the computations.

value.rationale: Kirillov index is a standard coadjoint/stabilizer invariant, not just a convenient numerical count. The theorem solves it for every genuine complete bipartite graph in the new class-three construction, detects a sharp four-cycle rank defect, and realizes a family in which the excess over the center grows. The previously available center dimensions and two-step index formula do not supply the result. The explicit unimodular constructive mechanism may support more general graph families.
